# Vendor hex files

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `micropython-microbit-v1.1.1.hex` | USB MicroPython flash (index.html) |
| `micropython-microbit-v2.1.2.hex` | USB MicroPython flash (index.html) |
| `neopixel-bluetooth-player.hex` | Custom CODAL BLE + NeoPixel player (bluetooth.html) |

Build `neopixel-bluetooth-player.hex` from `microbit-player/firmware/`
(GitHub Actions workflow `Build NeoPixel BLE player`, or local CODAL build).
